title: Review of lab 1's membrane_kinds (SIBD) on fresh seeds 7 and 8, with the first labkit packs of this world: walled cells from noise carry a link ring (rim/core 1.65 and 1.51, 72/84 and 61/83 individuals) and divide (13 and 7 persistent splits, generation 5 and 3)
summary: Ran threads/autopoiesis/worlds/membrane_kinds/world.py unchanged with labkit (128^2, t=10000) on seeds 7 and 8. From a noise start (sheet t=0) the phase separates by t~400 into discrete cells with a bright wall that grow, divide and sometimes dissolve; 10-28 cells, occupancy 0.11-0.29; a K2 mutant cell appears near t~9150 on seed 7. labkit: link L membrane-like in aggregate (rim/core 1.65 and 1.51, rim/out 4.7 and 5.5; 72/84 and 61/83 individuals), wall indicator likewise; 68 and 76 splits with 13 and 7 persistent (generation 5 and 3), merges 4 and 8. The links are made by each cell's catalyst and drift up the wall indicator, as in phase_membrane.

observations.S: rerun7/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun7/sheet.png: 10-22 discrete walled cells, roughly 8-30 px across, persisting between divisions
observations.B: rerun7/radial.png: L rim/core 1.65, rim/out 4.70, 72/84 membrane-like; seed 8 1.51 / 5.54, 61/83
observations.D: rerun7/lineage.png: 13 persistent splits, generation 5, merge/split 0.06; seed 8: 7, generation 3

seeds_run.result: pass: L ring 1.65 (72/84), 13 persistent splits gen 5
pass: L ring 1.51 (61/83), 7 persistent splits gen 3

not_checked: the L7 kinds claim (not part of this claim)
verdicts.limitation: labkit warns that 37-58 of 83-84 aggregate members are rings (the threshold separates some walls from cores), so the radial numbers are partly confounded, and seed 7's persistent-track area ratio (71) reflects that; the images show bounded walled cells. The ring is placed by a drift up the wall indicator (made by the cells' own catalyst). Seed 8's aggregate L ring is at the 1.5 bar. No resolution or dt test.
